claims.evidence: Witness report shows two lenses are present, but no clear view of exact lens model names/specs or markings to confirm 18-55mm and 50mm.

claims.claim: Clean and good to shoot videos and snapshots.
claims.evidence: No close-up of lens glass/condition and no sensor/test shots or functionality evidence in the witness report.

risks.risk: Exact camera model and whether it’s a basic/entry Nikon DSLR vs a higher-end body (affects value).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera body model name/number on the front/top and the rear label (or the menu “About/Model” screen).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unspecified Nikon DSLR body with unknown capabilities.

risks.risk: Lens specifications may not actually be 18-55mm and 50mm (could be different focal lengths or non-matching/third-party lenses).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both lenses showing the printed model/focal length/aperture markings (front ring and side text).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a Nikon DSLR kit with generic/unknown lenses.

risks.risk: Lens glass condition (fungus, haze, scratches) and whether optics are truly clean.
risks.proof: Macro/close-up shots of both lens front and rear elements against light, plus a photo of the inside rear element (rear cap removed if possible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as lenses with unknown optical condition (worst case: needs cleaning or has wear).

risks.risk: Camera functionality (autofocus, shutter, buttons/dials, video features) not verified.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing autofocus tracking and recording, plus a still photo and playback; also a photo of the rear screen showing settings/menu.

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dust, scratches, dead pixels) not shown.
risks.proof: A photo of the sensor test result (e.g., a “sensor cleaning/dust” test image) or a close-up of the sensor area (with safe handling).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, straps, lens caps/hoods) could reduce usability.
risks.proof: A full laid-out accessories photo showing every included item (battery model, charger, caps/hoods, strap, memory card).

risks.risk: Shutter count/usage history unknown; higher wear lowers value.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of shutter count from-camera or via a shutter count app (if available) or a service/usage record.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the exact Nikon DSLR model number/name on the body (front/top/rear label).
Close-up photos of both lenses showing printed focal length/aperture model markings (18-55 and 50 confirmation).
Macro close-ups of lens front and rear elements for scratches/fungus/haze (against light).
Short recorded video clip (10–20 seconds) showing autofocus and stable recording, plus a still photo and playback.
Photo/screenshot of sensor condition (dust test image) or a safe sensor close-up.
Full accessories layout photo: battery, charger, memory card, strap, lens caps/hoods (everything included).
Shutter count screenshot/photo (or any usage/service record).
response.reason: The witness confirms a Nikon DSLR body with two lenses, but the exact camera model, lens models, and condition/functionality are not verifiable from the report. Without those, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
